name: Mikami Haruka
source:
Likes: Funny things in general
Dislikes: Being forced to meet others' expectation
Hobbies: Making fun of others, reading

The student council president. She becomes Kenji's fiancée because his shared apartment with [url=/c13450]Misaki[/url] and the others is closer to the school and because she thinks its funny.
